listings.description: Bizionary is pleased to present an opportunity to acquire an established online tourism advertising and directory platform serving one of Cornwall’s most popular visitor destinations. Established in May 2023, this platform connects holiday accommodation providers, local businesses and services directly with visitors to the area. Unlike traditional booking platforms, the business does not charge commission on accommodation bookings, instead generating recurring revenue through annual advertising and listing subscriptions. The business has deliberately been developed with competitively priced advertising packages during its initial growth phase, with the founder focusing on building the advertiser base, website traffic, brand recognition and customer loyalty rather than maximising short-term revenue. This strategy has created an established platform which now has: ● 220+ paying advertisers since launch ● Approximately 4,000–5,000 monthly website visitors ● Approximately 20,000–25,000 weekly social media reach ● Strong advertiser renewal and retention ● Recurring annual subscription income ● Low operating costs ● A recognised local tourism brand ● A fully home-based and relocatable operating model Built to Scale Designed from the outset as a scalable online platform. The founder’s original strategy was to maintain accessible advertising prices during the establishment phase and progressively increase package pricing as the website’s audience, advertiser numbers and market presence developed. Based on an illustrative base of approximately 100 accommodation advertisers, the planned future package structure indicates potential accommodation advertising revenue of approximately £13,400–£17,500 per annum. When combined with local business advertising, the existing core advertising model illustrates potential annual revenue in the region of approximately £15,000–£21,000, before considering further advertiser growth or additional revenue streams. These figures are illustrative scenarios rather than forecasts or guarantees and will depend on pricing, advertiser retention and the strategy implemented by a purchaser. Significant Additional Growth Opportunities A new owner could build upon the existing platform through increased package pricing, premium and featured advertising products, additional SEO and Google Ads, increased social media marketing and expansion into neighbouring tourism destinations.

They also operate at various train stations across Cornwall which are used as pick-up and drop-off points. This offers flexibility and means that the business is fully relocatable within the area that is logistically covered. Business Description Veritas Business Sales are delighted to offer to the market this respected car hire business, which is located in Newquay. Established in 2000 by our client’s late father, the business has been family-operated ever since and is now reluctantly being offered for sale due to our client’s wish to relocate overseas. Cornwall Car Hire Limited offers flexible, hassle-free car hire across Cornwall, with locations in Newquay, St Austell, Bodmin, Truro, Redruth, Liskeard, Camborne, Penzance, Falmouth and St Ives The company is being sold as a limited company, making the transfer of the existing car hire contracts straightforward. The sale also includes a VW Crafter mobile office, which is fully equipped, together with six websites and social media accounts. For the year ended 31st December 2025, the company reported an annual turnover of £217,991 and a net profit of £55,605. Based on these figures, the asking price represents an attractive opportunity for a purchaser. We believe the business would suit an existing car hire company looking to expand through acquisition, or another car-related business with its own premises looking for a complementary bolt-on operation. The business has built a strong reputation within the local community and beyond and benefits from a 4.8 Google rating from 84 customer reviews. This represents an excellent opportunity to acquire an established, turnkey operation with significant scope for further growth. Early viewing is therefore highly recommended.
